description: Use when you need to screen a wallet address or a person/company name against sanctions lists before paying or trading: OFAC SDN, UK, EU, Canada and the US Consolidated Screening List in one call. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /sanctions/check, $0.005 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Sanctions lists only (OFAC SDN, UK, EU, Canada, US CSL). For a broader rule-based risk label use wallet_risk (addresses) or token_risk (tokens); for a list of addresses use sanctions_screening_batch. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.

address.description: crypto address to screen (send this or name)

min_score.description: name matches only: lowest similarity score to report

name.description: person or entity name in Latin letters (transliterated), at least one word of 3+ characters (send this or address)
